_about: The phase-16 sandbox of session B as built before its editor session (phase14/make_sandbox.sh, 2026-11-27): the base model's weight fingerprint and the digests of the tools the editor runs. Every pass summary carries both (`base_fingerprint`, a digest of the `harness` object below as `harness_digest`), so the session can be audited against this file. Committed before any pass of the session. The base model and the tools are those of phase 15.
